title: People do not know how dangerous lovesongs can be, the auric egg of Russell warned
html_source:
There is considerable cyphering and word play in this paragraph. (Knowles, S.D.G., Introduction, Bronze by Gold: The Music of Spheres).

Knowles argues the recurrence of a and e in the paragraph are a word play on ear which in turn is related to heart at the end of the paragraph – the meaning being that the way to the heart of Joyce is through the ear , through musicality of the words.
